items.quote: And the LORD said unto Moses, Write this for a memorial in a book, and rehearse it in the ears of Joshua: for I will utterly put out the remembrance of Amalek from under heaven.
items.claim: The LORD commanded Moses to write a memorial account and recite it to Joshua, and declared he would erase Amalek's memory from humanity.
items.action: said, Write, rehearse, utterly put out
items.mechanism: in a book, in the ears of Joshua
